summary: Fresh after the 2026 World Cup, but the top 10 is the football powers almost everyone names, so a casual player finds all 10.
reasons: Builder's own replays, pending a real judge (the builder knew the answers when writing them). Two casual orders found 10; the USA (#21), Mexico (#11) and Portugal (#13) are the misses.

Matches won, through 2026 (FIFA credits Germany with West Germany's record, Russia with the Soviet Union's). England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland are teams of their own; "uk" offers them. Countries that never played say so.
Likely too easy for Today's list; a judge may still like it, or as a Blitz.
fixes: If a judge agrees on free play, drop its `debut` flag in topics.ts, or it waits out of random play for good.
